description:
Approved by the user 2026-11-17 (relayed verbatim by JSON: "proceed."), E2 of https://claude.ai/artifact/BWdUAnALF2ekJXzZ8Vq63e.

Scope (lib/json.fz): the simple escapes become clauses of `escaped`; run_join gets an <<>> clause; \uXXXX is one clause guarded by is_hex on all four bytes; hex returns a plain integer. Deleted: simple_escape, join_run, hex4, hex4_join, and the `integer | :error` returns.

Evidence (bench, on #726): strings decode 28.83 -> 24.74 Mcycles (-14.2%); strings allocations 472k -> 312k, bytes 16.8 -> 11.6 MB; scalar boxes 80,000 -> 0; docs unchanged; all 54 JSON fixtures pass on three paths with identical outputs and error positions.

Done when: fixtures identical; a fixture pins scalar boxes per \uXXXX at 0 on all three paths; strings cycles re-measured.

Held (not filed): W (whitespace) waits on the leaf-call rule (fz-sc8.197).
title: A JSON escape is one clause, and a \uXXXX is decoded where it is matched
